title: We benchmarked the TOP AI Code Reviewers
summary: Augment Code promo citing a code-review benchmark where it leads on precision and recall.

assertions.quote: Codex actually has higher precision at 68% but look at the recall, 29% ... Claude Code ... 51% recall, but only 23% precision

verdicts.note: Independent and vendor benchmarks of PR review bots report recall well below 60% and wide precision variation; the specific ranking here is vendor-reported.

Across mainstream AI review techniques paired with leading LLMs on 1,000 real PRs with full repository context, the best combination reached only 19.38% F1, several produced multiple false positives per PR and four of five techniques had precision under 10%; no setup came close to finding most of the issues human reviewers raised.

Recall of the best AI review setup fell from 38.35% on PRs with one human-raised issue to 8.88% on PRs with five or more, while precision stayed roughly between 30% and 44%; it confirms tools miss most real issues in complex PRs, but this passage shows recall dropping with complexity rather than a precision-recall trade-off.

Of 5,594 confirmed customer-facing failures in 26,400 PRs, 83% were not flagged by either Claude Code or Cursor BugBot; supports that current tools miss most real production bugs, though it is a vendor benchmark and its failure set was chosen by the vendor's own tool.

assertions.quote: The hardest part of AI code review isn't generating the comments. It's assembling the right context

verdicts.note: As models improved, output depends more on relevant, high-signal context than phrasing; consistent with Anthropic/Cursor guidance and long-context degradation evidence.
